# Stage A: AM13E23019 build-only bring-up target.
#
# This file is included at the end of the pinned TI SDK top-level configure by
# tools/am13e/build-am13e-bringup.sh. It intentionally reuses the TI SDK
# libraries and the SysConfig output generated by the known-good empty
# LaunchPad smoke target.
#
# CMake does not permit add_subdirectory() during deferred execution, so this
# target is defined directly in the TI SDK top-level directory instead of
# creating a deferred subdirectory.

set(TARGET am13e23019_bringup)
set(TI_SDK_CONFIG ti_sdk_cfg_default)
set(AM13E_PLATFORM_DIR ${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR})
set(
    AM13E_EMPTY_SYSCFG_DIR
    ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/examples/empty/am13e230x_lp/m33_nortos/cmake_syscfg_generated
)

if(TARGET ${TARGET})
    return()
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED ESCAPE32_AM13E_OUTPUT_DIR)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "ESCAPE32_AM13E_OUTPUT_DIR is not defined")
endif()

file(GLOB AM13E_SYSCFG_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${AM13E_EMPTY_SYSCFG_DIR}/*.c"
)

if(NOT AM13E_SYSCFG_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "TI empty-example SysConfig output not found in "
        "${AM13E_EMPTY_SYSCFG_DIR}. Run the SDK smoke build first."
    )
endif()

set(LINKER_SCRIPT ${AM13E_PLATFORM_DIR}/linker_app.ld)

add_executable(${TARGET})

target_sources(${TARGET} PRIVATE
    ${AM13E_PLATFORM_DIR}/src/main.c
    ${AM13E_SYSCFG_SOURCES}
)

target_include_directories(${TARGET} PRIVATE
    ${AM13E_PLATFORM_DIR}
    ${AM13E_PLATFORM_DIR}/src
    ${AM13E_EMPTY_SYSCFG_DIR}
)

target_link_libraries(${TARGET} PRIVATE arch_${TI_SDK_CONFIG})
target_link_libraries(${TARGET} PRIVATE cmsis_core)
target_link_libraries(${TARGET} PRIVATE driverlib_${TI_SDK_CONFIG})
target_link_libraries(${TARGET} PRIVATE utils_nortos_${TI_SDK_CONFIG})
target_link_libraries(${TARGET} PRIVATE ${TI_SDK_DEVICE})

set_target_properties(${TARGET} PROPERTIES
    RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${ESCAPE32_AM13E_OUTPUT_DIR}"
)

# The E62 application owns only 0x00006000..0x0007FFFF. The dedicated
# linker script enforces that partition and retains TI's RAM/.TI.ramfunc model.
target_link_options(${TARGET} PRIVATE
    "${TOOLCHAIN_SET_MAP_PREFIX}${ESCAPE32_AM13E_OUTPUT_DIR}/${TARGET}.map"
    "${TOOLCHAIN_SET_LINKER_SCRIPT_PREFIX}${LINKER_SCRIPT}"
)
